parameters.query:
WITH u AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET current_stage='visuals',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='voiceover'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id AND s.status<>'timed')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.assets a JOIN public.scenes s ON s.id=a.scene_id WHERE s.job_id=j.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=j.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.job_id=j.id)
 RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) AS ready_to_run;

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::jsonb AS plans), parsed AS (
 SELECT x.* FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.plans) AS x(
   segment_number integer,first_scene_number integer,last_scene_number integer,start_seconds numeric,end_seconds numeric,duration_seconds numeric,
   narration text,support_evidence_ids jsonb,canonical_subject text,visual_target text,visual_lane text,visual_query text,visual_description text,planned_shot_count smallint
 )
), inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_segments(job_id,segment_number,first_scene_number,last_scene_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,narration,support_evidence_ids,canonical_subject,visual_target,visual_lane,visual_query,visual_description,planned_shot_count,status)
 SELECT i.job_id,p.segment_number,p.first_scene_number,p.last_scene_number,p.start_seconds,p.end_seconds,p.duration_seconds,p.narration,p.support_evidence_ids,p.canonical_subject,p.visual_target,p.visual_lane,p.visual_query,p.visual_description,p.planned_shot_count,'planned'
 FROM parsed p CROSS JOIN input i
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_segments old WHERE old.job_id=i.job_id)
 RETURNING id,segment_number
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM inserted) AS planned_count,
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('segment_id',id,'segment_number',segment_number) ORDER BY segment_number) FROM inserted),'[]'::jsonb) AS persisted_segments;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(item=>item.json).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.shot_number)-Number(b.shot_number));if(!rows.length)throw new Error('No semantic visual shots to download');const groups=new Map();for(const row of rows){const candidateId=String(row.candidate_id??'').trim(),downloadUrl=String(row.download_url??'').trim();if(!candidateId||!downloadUrl)throw new Error(`Shot ${row.shot_number} selected visual is incomplete`);let group=groups.get(candidateId);if(!group){group={...row,targets:[],storage_shot_number:Number(row.shot_number)};groups.set(candidateId,group);}if(String(group.download_url)!==downloadUrl)throw new Error(`Candidate ${candidateId} resolved to multiple download URLs`);group.targets.push(row);}return [...groups.values()].map(group=>({json:{...group,target_count:group.targets.length}}));

const stored=$json,group=$('Prepare Selected Download').item.json;const path=String(stored.visual_path??'').trim(),media=String(stored.media_type??'').trim(),w=Number(stored.width),h=Number(stored.height),bytes=Number(stored.bytes);if(!path||!['image','video'].includes(media)||!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0||!Number.isFinite(h)||h<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error(`Candidate ${group.candidate_id} media-worker returned invalid stored visual`);if(!Array.isArray(group.targets)||!group.targets.length)throw new Error(`Candidate ${group.candidate_id} lost shot targets`);return {json:{...group,stored_visual:{visual_path:path,media_type:media,width:w,height:h,bytes,duration_seconds:Number(stored.duration_seconds??0)||null}}};

parameters.query:
WITH segment AS (
 SELECT vs.id,vs.planned_shot_count FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.id=$2::uuid AND vs.job_id=$1::uuid AND vs.status='planned' FOR UPDATE
), library AS (
 INSERT INTO public.media_library_assets(provider,provider_asset_id,source_url,author,license,license_url,local_path,media_kind,visual_hash,canonical_subject,metadata,last_used_at)
 SELECT $7::text,$8::text,NULLIF($9::text,''),NULLIF($10::text,''),NULLIF($11::text,''),NULLIF($12::text,''),$13::text,$14::text,$15::text,$16::text,$17::jsonb,now() FROM segment
 ON CONFLICT(provider,provider_asset_id) DO UPDATE SET last_used_at=now(),metadata=public.media_library_assets.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata
 RETURNING id
), inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_shots(job_id,visual_segment_id,shot_number,segment_shot_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,media_library_asset_id,local_path,visual_cluster_key,visual_kind,selection_score,metadata)
 SELECT $1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::int,$4::smallint,$5::numeric,$6::numeric,($6::numeric-$5::numeric),library.id,$13::text,$18::text,$19::text,$20::numeric,$17::jsonb FROM library
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_shots old WHERE old.job_id=$1::uuid AND (old.shot_number=$3::int OR (old.visual_segment_id=$2::uuid AND old.segment_shot_number=$4::smallint)))
 RETURNING id,visual_segment_id
), completed AS (
 UPDATE public.visual_segments vs SET status='ready',updated_at=now() FROM segment s
 WHERE vs.id=s.id
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.visual_segment_id=vs.id)
   AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.visual_segment_id=vs.id)
        +(SELECT count(*) FROM inserted i WHERE i.visual_segment_id=vs.id))=s.planned_shot_count
 RETURNING vs.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::uuid AS segment_id,$3::int AS shot_number,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS shot_inserted,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS persisted,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM completed) AS segment_completed;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json),selected=$('Choose Visual Assignment').all().map(i=>i.json),expected=Number(selected[0]?.visual_quality_pre_render?.shot_count);if(!Number.isInteger(expected)||expected<=0)throw new Error('Selected shot count is invalid');if(rows.length!==expected)throw new Error(`Visual shot persistence returned ${rows.length}/${expected} rows`);const seen=new Set();let jobId='';for(const r of rows){if(r.persisted!==true)throw new Error(`Visual shot persistence failed for shot ${r.shot_number??'unknown'}`);const n=Number(r.shot_number);if(seen.has(n))throw new Error(`Duplicate persisted shot ${n}`);seen.add(n);const j=String(r.job_id??'');if(!jobId)jobId=j;else if(jobId!==j)throw new Error('Mixed jobs in visual shot persistence');}return [{json:{job_id:jobId,persisted_shot_count:rows.length,expected_shot_count:expected}}];

parameters.query:
WITH j AS (
 SELECT id,status,current_stage,voiceover_duration_seconds FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid AND content_model_version='staged_v1'
), segments AS (
 SELECT vs.*,lag(vs.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY vs.segment_number) AS previous_end FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=$1::uuid
), segment_quality AS (
 SELECT count(*)::int AS segment_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ready')::int AS ready_segment_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE segment_number<>row_number_value OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02)::int AS bad_segment_timing_count,
        COALESCE(max(end_seconds),0)::numeric AS final_segment_end
 FROM (SELECT segments.*,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY segment_number)::int AS row_number_value FROM segments) x
), shots AS (
 SELECT sh.*,a.provider||':'||a.provider_asset_id AS asset_key,lag(sh.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number) AS previous_end,
        lag(sh.visual_cluster_key) OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number) AS previous_cluster
 FROM public.visual_shots sh JOIN public.media_library_assets a ON a.id=sh.media_library_asset_id WHERE sh.job_id=$1::uuid
), shot_base AS (
 SELECT count(*)::int AS shot_count,count(DISTINCT media_library_asset_id)::int AS unique_asset_count,count(DISTINCT visual_cluster_key)::int AS unique_visual_cluster_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE shot_number<>row_number_value OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02 OR abs((end_seconds-start_seconds)-duration_seconds)>0.02)::int AS bad_shot_timing_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE previous_cluster IS NOT NULL AND visual_cluster_key=previous_cluster)::int AS adjacent_duplicate_count,
 COALESCE(max(duration_seconds),0)::numeric AS max_shot_duration,COALESCE(max(end_seconds),0)::numeric AS final_shot_end
 FROM (SELECT shots.*,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY shot_number)::int AS row_number_value FROM shots) x
), occurrences AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(max(n),0)::int AS max_cluster_occurrence FROM (SELECT visual_cluster_key,count(*)::int n FROM shots GROUP BY visual_cluster_key) x
), durations AS (
 SELECT visual_cluster_key,sum(duration_seconds)::numeric AS cluster_duration FROM shots GROUP BY visual_cluster_key
), shares AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(max(cluster_duration),0)::numeric/NULLIF((SELECT sum(duration_seconds) FROM shots),0)::numeric AS max_cluster_duration_share FROM durations
), quality AS (
 SELECT sq.segment_count,sq.ready_segment_count,sq.bad_segment_timing_count,sq.final_segment_end,sb.*,o.max_cluster_occurrence,COALESCE(sh.max_cluster_duration_share,0)::numeric AS max_cluster_duration_share,
        CEIL(sb.shot_count/2.0)::int AS required_unique_visual_cluster_count,
        (sq.segment_count>0 AND sq.ready_segment_count=sq.segment_count AND sq.bad_segment_timing_count=0 AND abs(sq.final_segment_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02
         AND sb.shot_count>0 AND sb.unique_visual_cluster_count>=CEIL(sb.shot_count/2.0)::int AND sb.bad_shot_timing_count=0
         AND sb.adjacent_duplicate_count=0 AND o.max_cluster_occurrence<=2 AND COALESCE(sh.max_cluster_duration_share,0)<=0.34
         AND abs(sb.final_shot_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02) AS pass
 FROM segment_quality sq CROSS JOIN shot_base sb CROSS JOIN occurrences o CROSS JOIN shares sh CROSS JOIN j
), persisted AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs jobs SET visual_quality=jsonb_build_object(
   'version','visual-segments-v3','segment_count',q.segment_count,'shot_count',q.shot_count,'unique_asset_count',q.unique_asset_count,'asset_reuse_count',(q.shot_count-q.unique_asset_count),'unique_visual_cluster_count',q.unique_visual_cluster_count,
   'required_unique_visual_cluster_count',q.required_unique_visual_cluster_count,'adjacent_visual_cluster_duplicate_count',q.adjacent_duplicate_count,
   'max_visual_cluster_occurrence_count',q.max_cluster_occurrence,'max_allowed_visual_cluster_occurrence_count',2,'max_visual_cluster_duration_share',round(q.max_cluster_duration_share,4),
   'max_allowed_visual_cluster_duration_share',0.34,'max_shot_duration_seconds',round(q.max_shot_duration,4),
   'all_assets_unique',(q.unique_asset_count=q.shot_count),'pre_render_pass',q.pass,'pass',q.pass
 ),updated_at=now() FROM quality q WHERE jobs.id=$1::uuid RETURNING jobs.visual_quality
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,j.status,j.current_stage,q.*,(SELECT visual_quality FROM persisted LIMIT 1) AS visual_quality,
 (j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='visuals' AND q.pass) AS all_visuals_ready
FROM j CROSS JOIN quality q;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json;if(r.all_visuals_ready!==true)throw new Error(`Semantic visual completion failed: segments=${r.ready_segment_count}/${r.segment_count}, shots=${r.shot_count}, clusters=${r.unique_visual_cluster_count}/${r.required_unique_visual_cluster_count}, assets=${r.unique_asset_count}/${r.shot_count}, adjacent=${r.adjacent_duplicate_count}, max_occurrence=${r.max_cluster_occurrence}, max_share=${r.max_cluster_duration_share}, max_shot=${r.max_shot_duration}`);if(!r.visual_quality||r.visual_quality.version!=='visual-segments-v3'||r.visual_quality.pre_render_pass!==true)throw new Error('Durable semantic visual pre-render quality was not persisted');return [{json:{job_id:r.job_id,visuals_ready:true,visual_quality:r.visual_quality}}];

const received=$('Receive Job ID').first().json??{};const normalize=v=>String(v??'').trim().toLowerCase();const jobId=normalize(received.job_id||$json.job_id||$json.requested_job_id);if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(jobId))throw new Error('Visual failure handler could not recover job_id');const vals=[$json.details?.description,$json.error?.message,$json.error?.description,typeof $json.error==='string'?$json.error:null,$json.message,$json.errorMessage];const message=String(vals.find(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())||'Visual stage failed').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,4000);return {json:{job_id:jobId,last_error:message}};

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='visuals',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;

),normalized_bytes:Number(stored.bytes),normalized_duration_seconds:stored.duration_seconds,stored_by:'media-worker'}}});}}out.sort((a,b)=>a.json.shot_number-b.json.shot_number);return out;
